fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at either road connection. NE driveway off Eastgate Pkwy has only a directional 'TRUCKS ONLY / VISITORS' sign at the road (confirmed in 2024-06 Street View) - an open uncontrolled drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed booth visible at any entrance in satellite or Street View.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False - requires a truck gate to exist; there is none.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long open driveway wraps the building from the NE entrance around the north dock face; ample room for a 3+ truck queue inside.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large NW drop yard with trailers parked nose-out in multiple rows (50+ stalls observed in z20 imagery).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: North building face shows a regular rhythm of dock doors with trailers backed in; estimated ~40, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open driveway apron at NE entrance with unused paved width and no existing control structure - physical room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs parallel to Eastgate Pkwy along the south of the property but no spur enters the site.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in a built-up industrial park in Gahanna within the Columbus OH metro; dense surrounding warehouse/commercial fabric and residential subdivisions nearby.
